command_help.cast:
cast [--fps N] [--loop] <url>
  Fetch and replay an asciicast v2 (.cast) recording file.
  Supports http://, https://, and file:// URLs.
  --fps N    playback speed (default: 15)
  --loop     repeat the recording until interrupted
command_help.clear: clear — erase the terminal screen (ANSI reset).
command_help.env: env — show available context keys and their types.
command_help.exit: exit / quit — end this shell session.
command_help.fetch:
fetch [-X METHOD] <url> [body] — HTTP request.
  Default method is GET.  Use -X POST, -X PUT, etc. to change it.
  Optional body is sent as the request body.
command_help.help: help [cmd] — show all commands or detail for <cmd>.
command_help.kv:
kv list                  — list all KV keys with session: prefix.
kv get <key>             — read a KV value (session: prefix added if absent).
kv set <key> <value>     — write a KV entry.
kv delete <key>          — delete a KV entry.
command_help.py:
py <expr> — evaluate a Python expression or exec a statement.
Variables persist across py calls for the session lifetime.
Available: json, datetime, re, hashlib, base64, plus safe builtins.
command_help.quit: exit / quit — end this shell session.
command_help.render:
render [--mode truecolor|256|16] [--cols N] [--rows N] [--fps N] [--loop] <url>
  Render an image as ANSI art in the terminal.
  Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, APNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, and more.
  Animated images stream frames; use --loop to repeat.
  Requires: pip install 'provide-uterm[emulator]'
command_help.sessions:
sessions — list all sessions from the KV registry.
sessions kill <id> — force-terminate a session Durable Object.
command_help.storage:
storage list         — list all DO storage keys.
storage get <key>    — read a DO storage value by key.
